relationships.subject: sensory neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: optogenetic activation of sensory neurons significantly accelerated tumor growth following orthotopic transplantation of murine TNBC cells

relationships.subject: dynorphin
relationships.evidence_quote: in vitro treatment with dynorphin enhanced the cytotoxic efficacy of docetaxel, accompanied by the inhibition of PI3K-Akt signaling

relationships.subject: nalfurafine methiodide
relationships.evidence_quote: in vivo administration of the peripherally restricted KOR agonist nalfurafine methiodide markedly suppressed tumor growth
